purpose: Repair the two P31 review blockers before any production implementation: exact repo-local Authority identity and executable zero-mutation RED oracles.

authority_reconciliation.rule: Every implementation-relevant Authority is bound to a repository-resolvable materialized file plus its Git blob SHA-1 and exact byte SHA-256. External provider identity and revision remain recorded when present.

bindings.scope_note: This Authority remains an FC-track dependency only; it does not authorize FC-01 implementation in this task.

authority_reconciliation.history_rule: No Authority, Gate, Integration or Evidence record is modified by this correction. Superseded authorities remain preserved in .aegis/authorities.json.

red_oracles.requirement: A source loss/unregister must deliver a keyed Cancel to the real session owner without cancelling another source.
red_oracles.baseline_failure_mode: RuntimeAppBinding::notifySourceLost discards the normalized cancel result and unregisterInputSource removes only registration; no owner delivery seam exists.
red_oracles.independent_observation: Read-only source oracle inspects the composition boundary for a cancellation sink/return path and proves the baseline has a discarded result plus no unregister cancellation call.
red_oracles.post_fix_acceptance: A separate accepted P32 owner-adapter test must require a typed owner delivery port, a returned/forwarded keyed Cancel, and unregister routing through the same source-scoped path. This read-only RED oracle is not reused as the post-fix acceptance oracle.

red_oracles.requirement: Control snapshot/readback must report real owner availability, writability and busy state.
red_oracles.baseline_failure_mode: CanvasControlBinding::snapshot hard-codes targetAvailable=true, writable=true and busy=false.
red_oracles.independent_observation: Read-only source oracle locates literal unconditional assignments and verifies no owner-state port is read for these fields.
red_oracles.post_fix_acceptance: A separate accepted P32 owner-state test must drive unavailable, writable, and busy states through a test-only owner adapter and compare snapshot/readback to those values. This read-only RED oracle is not reused as the post-fix acceptance oracle.

independence_and_limits.why_not_a_production_test: The pre-mutation RED is intentionally a read-only source/contract oracle. It does not require adding an owner port before the defect is observed and cannot be made green by changing only the oracle.
independence_and_limits.later_green_oracle: After P32 implementation, focused runtime tests with a test-only owner adapter and degraded owner state must exercise the corrected contracts; those tests are acceptance evidence, not this P20 RED proof.
